status.en: 32 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 113% more than the week before, most of them in Darfur, Khartoum and Kordofan.
status.nb: 32 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 113 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Darfur, Khartoum og Kordofan.

summary.en: Intensified fighting in Sudan sees RSF drone strikes killing four near Khartoum and damaging a United Nations building, while separate drone attacks hit homes and UN premises in the capital. The Rapid Support Forces also continue ground offensives, with recent attacks on aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan causing civilian casualties. Humanitarian conditions are worsening as charity kitchens in Khartoum shut and displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, face severe hardship. The conflict resulted in 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Intensivert kamp i Sudan fører til at RSF-militsen utfører droneram som dreper fire nær Khartoum og skader en bygning til FN, mens separate droneram treffer boliger og FN-lokaler i hovedstaden. RSF-militsen fortsetter også bakkekampanjer, med nylige angrep på hjelpearbeid i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan som forårsaker sivile tap. Humanitære forhold forverres etter at veldedige kjøkken i Khartoum stenger og fortrengte sudanere, særlig eldre, møter alvorlige vanskeligheter. Konflikten resulterte i 4 680 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
